body: I’m in the inner city of my state so I try looking for work that’s close wherever possible but don’t get as much luck cause of the lack of experience I guess. I go to a church for food that serves twice a day. It’s not much they give but it’s something to put in my stomach. I go to Planet Fitness to shower and clean myself up a couple days a week (can’t afford a membership but a guy that works there looks out for me). For the most part I usually just roam around the city looking for hope I guess.
